reference_sql:
WITH days AS (
  -- one row per store and day with orders
  SELECT DISTINCT store_code, order_date
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
), gaps AS (
  -- one row per store and day with orders
  SELECT store_code,
    order_date - LAG(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY store_code ORDER BY order_date) AS gap_days
  FROM days
)
SELECT store_code, MAX(gap_days) AS max_gap_days
FROM gaps
WHERE gap_days IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY store_code

WITH days AS (
  -- one row per store and day with orders
  SELECT DISTINCT store_code, order_date
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
), gaps AS (
  -- one row per store and day with orders
  SELECT d.store_code,
    d.order_date - (SELECT MAX(d2.order_date) FROM days d2 WHERE d2.store_code = d.store_code AND d2.order_date < d.order_date) AS gap_days
  FROM days d
)
SELECT store_code, MAX(gap_days) AS max_gap_days
FROM gaps
WHERE gap_days IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY store_code

  SELECT DISTINCT store_code, order_date
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
), g AS (
  SELECT store_code,
    order_date - LAG(order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY store_code ORDER BY order_date) AS gap

)
SELECT store_code, MAX(gap) AS max_gap_days
